problem: The KDE tray has a Lay enabled checkbox but no explicit daemon restart. The user requests direct enable/disable/restart controls and immediate installation on remote KDE.
decision: Expose a top-level Daemon Lay submenu with start/stop/restart. All three dispatch through the existing lay-runtime-control shell owner and target only lay-daemon.service. Preserve the original full-runtime Lay enabled checkbox and its input-channel semantics.
guard_change: The old source test banned a restart label anywhere in the KDE file. Scope that prohibition to its actual diagnostic submenu while retaining global bans in the unchanged GNOME tray/settings. Assert the daemon submenu is outside diagnostics. Actual shell/Qt tests enforce the resulting behavior and error reporting; the old implementation must fail them.
safety: No new process/input owner, physical listener, IME delivery path, source selection, automatic privilege grant, IBus/Plasma restart or browser acceptance. A requested daemon-only restart must preserve IBus and user fields.
